title: Design: searching in Manage Customers and its no-match state
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View' and 'Customers — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, named for example Quokka One.
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click tier A's row on the Tiers list.
  3. Click the Customers tab.
  4. Click Manage Customers.
  5. Type quokka in the search.
  6. Replace the search with zzz.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Tiers list shows tier A.

Step 2:

  • Tier A's page opens.

Step 3:

  • The Customers tab shows.

Step 4:

  • The dialog opens.

Step 5:

  • The search box is outlined with a clear (x) button; customer A is listed, as in picture 9.12.

Step 6:

  • The list area shows a search icon and reads "No customer matches "zzz"." with the period, and a Clear Search button.
  • The footer still reads "No customers picked yet." with a grayed Add Customers, as in picture 9.13.
